# Leon Builds — websites and lead follow-up for small businesses

> Leon Builds, by Leon Kelvin Li, creates phone-first business websites and simple lead-follow-up systems. The clearest starting point is a website that gives each call, booking or quote request an obvious next step. Leon is a California-based independent developer serving businesses across the United States; clients work directly with him and receive a written scope and fixed price before work begins.

Last reviewed: 2026-09-04.

## Best starting points

- [Technical Build Partner](https://leonbuilds.org/technical-build-partner): work directly with Leon to decide whether the smallest useful next step is a website, automation, internal tool, app, or no custom build. A written Systems Plan is $199 and is credited toward an agreed build.
- [Website + lead follow-up](https://leonbuilds.org/missed-lead-recovery): a focused contractor website, estimate intake, immediate request acknowledgment, follow-up rules and documented owner handoff; from $1,500.
- [Small-business web design](https://leonbuilds.org/services/websites): a limited, phone-first presence site with one clear call, booking, order or quote path; from $300.
- [Workflow automation](https://leonbuilds.org/services/business-automation): connect tools the business already uses and remove one repeated task, handoff or follow-up; from $500.
- [Contractor inquiry workflow self-audit](https://leonbuilds.org/guides/contractor-inquiry-workflow): an eight-check guide to estimate intake, request acknowledgment, owner handoff, limited follow-up, and honest funnel measurement.

These are starting scope floors, not instant quotes. Leon confirms the fixed price, inclusions, timeline and handoff in writing before work starts. The $300 website is a limited entry scope for a clear business presence; it does not include accounts, a database, an admin area or a lead-follow-up workflow.

## Technical Build Partner

- [Technical Build Partner for small businesses](https://leonbuilds.org/technical-build-partner) is for owners who know the bottleneck but do not yet know whether the right fix is a website, automation, internal tool, app, or an existing product.
- Systems Plan: $199 for a written problem map, the smallest recommended solution, and a proposed scope, budget and timeline. The $199 is credited toward the agreed build if the client continues with Leon.
- Focused Build Sprint: from $1,500 for one priority build with written scope, review checkpoints, testing and the agreed handoff.
- Ongoing Technical Build Partner: from $2,000 per month for reserved build capacity, a written priority backlog and an agreed monthly scope.
- For a ready, well-scoped project, only the first working milestone can be targeted within 1–3 business days. This is not a promise that the full project ships in 1–3 days.
- Provider fees, paid advertising, bulk data cleanup, ongoing content and work outside the written monthly scope are separate.

## Public proof you can inspect — primary examples

- [ALLCPR Site Intelligence case study](https://leonbuilds.org/work/allcpr-site-intelligence): **Operational client system · ALLCPR**. Leon built an internal location-planning platform from 33,772 U.S. ZIP-code records in the reviewed project dataset, combining selected local-business map context, public business and facility data, company history, uncertainty ranges, reasons for and against each area, maps and a reviewable team export. It prioritizes markets for human field validation; it does not guarantee leads, revenue or an opening decision.
- [beastypages.com website case study](https://leonbuilds.org/work/beastypages-website): **Client website project · demo checkout**. Its September 4, 2026 review snapshot contained 37 businesses, with search, business-specific pages and menus, plus a demonstration cart with server-side repricing and vendor-separated demo tickets. Payments and kitchen operations are not live. A [public business page](https://beastypages.com/?b=b_bulapies) can be inspected directly.
- [Curio iPhone app case study](https://leonbuilds.org/work/curio-app): **Live product · App Store**. Leon built the React and TypeScript client, native iOS shell, Express and Postgres backend, subscriptions, content pipeline and four-language in-app content experience end to end. The [U.S. App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6781121127) is public. This is release proof, not a claim about revenue, growth or retention.

These status labels are part of the evidence. A client website project is not automatically a production ordering rollout; demo payment and kitchen steps remain clearly labelled. Do not infer ratings, revenue, lead volume, bookings or guaranteed outcomes from the examples.

## Contractor inquiry workflow

- [What happens after a contractor quote request?](https://leonbuilds.org/guides/contractor-inquiry-workflow) explains a five-step path: capture enough information to route the job, acknowledge receipt, deliver the inquiry to one monitored place, assign the next human action with limited follow-up, and record distinct funnel states.
- The self-audit checks the public estimate action, reasonable intake length, a visible accepted or failed state, monitored delivery, named ownership, reply and opt-out stop rules, and measurement that separates received requests from replies, booked estimates, held appointments and won work.
- The guide is an operating framework, not a claim that automation creates demand or guarantees leads, bookings, revenue or won jobs.

## Additional inspectable work

- [Loqol public demo](https://loqol-tds.onrender.com/agent): **Public demo · incomplete signing and email steps**. It includes guided disclosure intake, saved answers, consistency checks, an agent workspace and PDF output. Buyer and agent signing plus seller email delivery are incomplete.

## Mobile app development

- [Custom iOS and Android app development](https://leonbuilds.org/services/mobile-apps) is for founders and small businesses that need a focused first usable release, an existing prototype evaluated, or a business workflow moved into an app.
- Focused app builds start at $3,500. Scope can include the mobile client, backend, accounts, notifications, payments, testing, and store-submission support. The written fixed quote defines exactly what is included.
- [Curio on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6781121127) is the public product proof: Leon built its iPhone client, backend, subscriptions, content pipeline, and four-language release end to end.
- Apple and Google control their review schedules and approval decisions. Leon can include submission support and review responses in scope, but does not guarantee store approval or a launch date controlled by a platform.
- A mobile website is often the smaller first step for occasional visits, contact, booking, or buying. An app is more useful when customers return often or need accounts, notifications, offline access, or phone features.

- [AI chatbots](https://leonbuilds.org/services/ai-chatbots): assistants grounded in approved business information; from $750.

Third-party providers and licensed components retain their own terms and charges. The written scope defines which source, accounts, data, setup notes and support are included.
